create_constant_component: create a Constant component with a given state string and optional pre_act_label
get_constant_state: get the state dictionary containing state and pre_act_label from a Constant component
set_constant_state: set the state of a Constant component by passing a state dictionary
get_dynamic_state: get the dynamic state variables of a Constant component that can be edited at runtime
make_pre_act_value: call _make_pre_act_value to log and return the constant state value
